title: Hybridization-proximity labeling reveals spatially ordered interactions of nuclear RNA compartments
boundary: Digoxigenin-labelled antisense probes recruit a compact DIG-binding/APEX2 fusion to selected RNA in fixed, genetically unmodified cells. Local biotinylation followed by crosslink reversal and denaturing streptavidin capture produces proximal-RNA sequencing material. This probe-recruited enzyme/substrate boundary differs from genetically targeted APEX-seq/APEX-RIP; bait panels and parallel HyPro-MS are not separate NGS entries.

title: A cost-effective RNA sequencing protocol for large-scale gene expression studies
boundary: PolyA-selected fragmented RNA is reverse-transcribed with an adaptor-tailed random hexamer; RNaseA/H removes RNA and T4RNA-ligase1 attaches the opposite partial sequencing adaptor directly to single-stranded cDNA before indexed PCR. This single-strand cDNA ligation route differs from dUTP-marked second-strand selection and template-switch/tagmentation libraries; larger sample throughput or RT-enzyme comparisons are not additional methods.
